description: This file defines the Metrics interface in Java, which specifies methods for tracking service metrics such as service rate, total events, thresholds, and resetting metrics. It is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.base.metrics package and is used for monitoring service performance within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Metrics
classes.description: An interface that declares methods for tracking and retrieving service metrics such as name, service rate, threshold, total events, and methods for recording service times and resetting metrics.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the metric.

methods.name: getServiceRate
methods.description: Returns a moving average of the service rate in milliseconds, with smoothing applied.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Returns the metric threshold used for comparison by client code.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total number of processed events.

methods.name: recordServiceRate
methods.description: Records service time for a number of events, given in milliseconds.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics to initial state.
